Senior Full Stack Engineer - Bangalore (Hybrid)

About the role
We're looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of experience to own features end-to-end across our React/Next.js frontend and Python/FastAPI backend. You'll design PostgreSQL data models, deploy services to AWS with Terraform and Kubernetes, and integrate LLM-powered workflows into our internal platforms.

What you'll do
- Build and ship product features in React, TypeScript and Next.js
- Design and operate FastAPI microservices with Celery/SQS background workers
- Own CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and Docker
- Partner with design on our component library in Storybook
- Instrument services with Sentry and improve observability

What we're looking for
- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
- Strong React and TypeScript skills; Next.js in production
- Python backend experience (FastAPI or Django) and PostgreSQL
- Hands-on AWS (S3, RDS, IAM) and Kubernetes experience
- Bonus: experience with RAG architectures, prompt engineering, or FFmpeg media pipelines

Hiring manager: Priya Nair, Engineering Manager. Recruiter contact: rahul.mehta@acme.com
